evals.prompt: We want to add a 'want-to-buy' feature to a used-book trading app: a user can post a book they want (title, target price, condition requirement), and sellers who have it can see the post and get in touch. Write a requirements document for engineering.
evals.expected_output: A PRD focused on this feature: product/feature intro; (if new entities) E-R diagram; role-permission; business/page flowcharts; global states; per-page four-dimension function & interaction spec (fields with data sources, state transitions, normal and abnormal interactions); page numbers; non-functional requirements; change log. Reasonably trimmed for an iteration (no industry overview).

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for the 'employee permission management' module of an admin back-office system, with three roles (super admin, department admin, regular employee), able to assign roles, add/remove employees, and control menu visibility.
evals.expected_output: A B2B PRD emphasizing the role-permission matrix, an E-R diagram (employee/role/permission relationships), fields with data sources, state transitions, permission-related exceptions (unauthorized access, expired session), and non-functional requirements; clear structure carried in tables.

evals.prompt: Write a requirements doc for the order-list page of a B2C food-delivery app: it should show in-progress and historical orders, and allow cancel, reorder, and rate.
evals.expected_output: A B2C single-page PRD: fields-and-data-sources table; preconditions/sort/refresh; order state transitions; normal and abnormal interactions (empty list, load failure, order already canceled, double click, etc.); reuse of global states; page numbering; no redundant industry overview.

evals.prompt: We already shipped a campaign performance report. The boss redrew the Overview and Influencer screens: the platform breakdown should become single-select chips, add a publish-date range to the Overview, and add a Geo filter to the Influencer table. Write the v2 PRD for engineering.
evals.expected_output: An iteration PRD that specs the delta, not the whole product: a change-points table (v1 vs v2 with a build-impact column) plus a stated 'everything else unchanged'; recurring metric calibers captured as global rules cited by ID rather than restated; an open-questions table where every row carries a default (and resolved ones are marked in place); decision-driven writing (a control the demo drew but a later decision cut is recorded as deferred, not shown as buildable). Numbered page annotations tie the spec to the redrawn screens; industry overview omitted. May optionally be delivered as a self-contained annotated HTML PRD (annotated-mockup triad + verification).
